īsa: [Īsa+a] (pu) CL=8  Dhāna,ṭī.725] Government, Lord. Īsa(bya)easily, not tired,  īsaṃ(1) - see meaning.

[Īsassayo-puda] (bya) CL=8 Rupaprīḥpuṃkiu prachiurā nyāsa,560-sutanhaṅa့, rū,604-5-In sutatiu့ niggahitakhyerana maprachiusaphraṅa့ niggahitamaဲ့ īsanipātahu chiuliuhanatūsañña. Bālāvatāraṭīkā, In nhā-326  īsaṃsaddā၏ achuṃḥphracaso niggahitakiu tesuvuddhicasaññaphraṅa့ khyerana prachiuthāḥsokroṅa့ 4ṅaḥaliu niggahitanhaṅa့ of īsaṃnipātaphraca.(īpata-saṃ)] (1) easily, not tired. (2) a little , a bit, a little.
īsadhara: [Īsa+dhara+a] (pu) CL=8 Dhāna,ṭī.26] mountain named Īsadhara, it is one among seven mountains which are surrounded the Mount Mraṅaḥmiura, The mountain is submerged in the ocean up to 21,000 Yuzana, and up to 21,000 Yuzana rises above the ocean.
īsakaggapavellita: [Īsakaṃ+agga+pavellita] (ti) CL=8 (A) slightly bent at the tip; (b) slightly bent like the tip of Sanalyaka (a sword for King).
īsakāyatagīva: [Īsakaṃ+āyata+gīvā] (ti) CL=8 Slightly longer neck like thill of a coach.
īsanasīla: [Īsana+sīla] (ti) CL=8 who used to overwhelm and ill-treate; he.
īsanaṭṭha: [Īsana+attha] (pu) CL=8 meaning of Overwhelmed and ill-treated.
īsaṃ: [Īsassayo-puda] (bya) CL=8 Rupaprīḥpuṃkiu prachiurā nyāsa,560-sutanhaṅa့, rū,604-5-In sutatiu့ niggahitakhyerana maprachiusaphraṅa့ niggahitamaဲ့ īsanipātahu chiuliuhanatūsañña. Bālāvatāraṭīkā, In nhā-326  īsaṃsaddā၏ achuṃḥphracaso niggahitakiu tesuvuddhicasaññaphraṅa့ khyerana prachiuthāḥsokroṅa့ 4ṅaḥaliu niggahitanhaṅa့ of īsaṃnipātaphraca.(īpata-saṃ)] (1) easily, not tired. (2) a little , a bit, a little.
īsikā: [Īsā+ka+ā] (thī) CL=8 Vi,pi,dhāna.(īpikā-saṃ)]  (1) spout.(2) core, pith, (3) thorns.
īsā: [Īsa+a+ā(itthījotaka)(īpā-saṃ)] (thī) CL=8 shaft of a coach, shaft of a harrow.
īsābaddha: [Īsā+baddha] (ti) CL=8 it is formed with shaft of  a coach (that is Hirī).
īsādanta: [Īsā+danta] (ti) CL=8 it is with tasks like shaft of a coach (creatures/living being, elephant).
īsāmūla: [Īsā+mūla] (na) CL=8 The origin of the shaft of a coach.
īsāna: [Yādicchakanāma.(īgāna-saṃ] (pu) CL=8 Amara,1.32)] This deity named Īsāsana.
īsī: [Īsa+ī] (ti) CL=8 government (or) who governed; he.  īsitā- see.
